_comment: Hand-written FAKE tickets for the synthetic stand-in app (Jira API v2 export shape, wiki markup). Not real data.

fields.summary: Invited editors end up with the viewer role
fields.description:
When an admin invites someone as an editor, the new user shows up as a viewer.

h3. Steps to Reproduce
# Go to Users and click *Invite user*
# Enter an email address and choose the role {{editor}}
# Click *Send invite*

h3. Expected Behavior
The user list shows the new user with the role editor.

h3. Actual Behavior
The user list shows the role viewer.

Searching the item list misses items whose names use different capitalization.

h3. Steps to Reproduce
# Create items named {{desk-lamp}} and {{Desk-Chair}}
# On the Items page, search for {{desk}}

h3. Expected Behavior
Both items are listed.

h3. Actual Behavior
Only {{desk-lamp}} is listed.

fields.summary: Items can be saved with quantity 0
fields.description:
The item editor accepts a quantity of 0 or a negative number.

h3. Steps to Reproduce
# Open the item editor (*New item*)
# Enter a name and set quantity to {{0}} (typing it or pasting it)
# Click *Save*

h3. Expected Behavior
The form shows the error "Quantity must be at least 1" and no item is created.

h3. Actual Behavior
The item is created with quantity 0.

fields.summary: Cancelling an order leaves it open
fields.description:
Clicking *Cancel order* on an open order shows a success message, but the order stays open and the stock is not returned.

h3. Steps to Reproduce
# Place an order for 2 units of an item
# Open the order and click *Cancel order*

h3. Expected Behavior
The order status is cancelled and the 2 units are back in stock.

h3. Actual Behavior
The status stays open.

fields.summary: Weekly digest setting is not saved
fields.description:
Turning on the weekly digest and saving shows "Settings saved", but after a reload the checkbox is off again.

h3. Steps to Reproduce
# Open Settings, then Notifications
# Tick *Weekly digest* and click *Save*
# Reload the page

h3. Expected Behavior
The weekly digest stays enabled.

h3. Actual Behavior
It is disabled again.

fields.summary: Timezone resets after reloading general settings
fields.description:
A saved timezone is shown correctly right after saving, but the page shows UTC again after a reload.

h3. Steps to Reproduce
# Open Settings
# Choose {{America/New_York}} and click *Save*
# Reload the page

h3. Expected Behavior
The timezone selector still shows America/New_York.

h3. Actual Behavior
It shows UTC.
